title: Equipment
subtitle: Every equipment in the plant with its last known status. The colour comes from the last measured round.

table.title: List
table.hint: TAG is the customer's code; it can repeat between motor and pump.

structure.title: Plant structure
structure.subtitle: Built top-down: plant → area → sector → machine train. Equipment hangs off the train.
structure.areasHint: With their code, as in the customer's sheet: 501 - PACKAGING CERVEZA
structure.sectorsHint: The grouping inside an area: KIT BOMBAS AGUA CRUDA
structure.groupsHint: What gets aligned and reported together
structure.name: Name
structure.sectorIdHint: Create it above and use the number it returns
structure.noAreas: Create an area and a sector first
structure.kindHint: Sets the point template that will be applied
structure.deleteHint: If it holds anything or has history, it is deactivated instead of deleted, and its reports stay complete.

form.equipmentHint: Equipment hangs off a machine train. If it does not exist yet, create it in Plant structure.
form.assetGroupHint: The train: motor + pump, motor + compressor…
form.name: Name
form.clientTagHint: Optional. It can repeat between motor and pump; the internal code is generated.
form.lubricationRequiredHint: A blower can run on oil or grease: pick one
form.pointsHint: Two points with H, V and A axes. Motors usually start at 1 and driven machines at 3.
form.firstPointHint: First point number; blank continues the train's numbering
form.standardHint: Which norma judges this equipment (Settings → Normas).
form.ownStandardHint: For equipment outside the standard (e.g. built to order): judged by this norma only, even when the report cites another. Changing it regrades its readings.

kinds.title: Train types
kinds.subtitle: Each type defines which machines the train is made of and how many points are measured. It is what makes a new train produce the rows of the real report.
kinds.formHint: Define the components and, below, the layout point by point: number, axis, side and what is measured.
kinds.emptyBody: Create the first one: Motor + Pump, Motor + Turbine…
kinds.componentsHint: In order: the driver first, then the driven machine.
kinds.layoutHint: One line per point. Tap an axis to choose what is read on it.
kinds.pointCountHint: How many points are read on this component
kinds.drift: {{label}} declares {{declared}} points and the template carries {{actual}}.
kinds.magnitudesHint: If the train also gets ultrasound or thermography, tick its magnitude here. Existing trains receive it with “Apply the kind's template”, keeping their readings.
kinds.searchHint: Kind name, a train's name or a machine TAG (e.g. MR311003)
kinds.noMatchHint: The search looks at the kind's name, its trains' names and their machines' TAG or name.
kinds.sharedBy_one: {{count}} train uses it. Changes apply to trains created from now on; to adjust a single one, use “Points” in Structure.
kinds.sharedBy_other: {{count}} trains use it. Changes apply to trains created from now on; to adjust a single one, use “Points” in Structure.
kinds.rebuildBody: Every point is rebuilt from the components and manual changes to the template are lost. Nothing is saved until you press “Save”.
kinds.orphansHint: Their component is no longer in the kind: remove them or add it back.
kinds.editAxis: What is read on point {{number}}, axis {{axis}}
kinds.noCatalogue: Install “Measurements” to choose what is read.
kinds.lastAxis: It is the point's only axis: remove the point instead.

points.title: Points of {{group}}
points.hint: Points are what readings hang off. Applying the template fills what is missing without touching what is there.
points.none: This equipment has no points yet

trains.title: Assets
trains.subtitle: One row per rotating train, with its machines inside. The colour is the worst of its machines; a machine that is off does not show its last verdict.
